summary: password_hash parameters: required secret, hashtype (default sha512; md5, blowfish, sha256, sha512, bcrypt), ident, rounds, and salt (letters, digits, . and /).
questions: What is the default algorithm for password_hash?
How do I set the number of rounds for password_hash?
What characters can a password_hash salt contain?

answer_card.title: password_hash parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `_input` (string, required): secret to hash
- `hashtype` (default `sha512`): `md5`, `blowfish`, `sha256`, `sha512`, `bcrypt`
- `ident`: algorithm identifier
- `rounds`: number of rounds (default varies by algorithm)
- `salt`: if omitted a random one can be generated; use only characters matching `[./0-9A-Za-z]+`
